name: Aegis Knight-Houses
identity: Feudal houses of steam-and-ion war-walkers with squire retainers. Few, huge models whose shields only face forward: the opponent wins by flanking, the knight player wins by turning to meet them and by the joust.

rules.name: Ion Bulwark & Thunderous Joust
rules.description: Class 3–5 units have WARD 5+ against ranged attacks from models whose bases are in their front 180° arc (mark the front of the base). Class 3–5 units that charged trigger Crushing Impact for 0 CP and their melee weapons gain [CRASHING] that activation.

rules.name: Gamble — Vent the Reactor
rules.description: When a Class 3–5 unit activates: its front-arc WARD becomes 4+ and its weapons get +1 Attack until the End of Round. At the End of Round roll a D6: on 1–2 it suffers D3 Fatal Wounds. (Risk: durability (dice).)

detachments.name: Noble Lance
detachments.playstyle: Big knights, few retainers: win the duels and the joust.

rules.name: Chivalric Code
rules.description: Before the battle pick 1 Oath (Slay the Warlord · Hold the Line · Lay Low the Tyrant [a Class 4–5 unit]). When it is fulfilled your army becomes Honoured: +1 CP each Command Phase and Class 4–5 units get UNYIELDING 6+.

enhancements.name: Mantle of the Liege
enhancements.description: **High Baron in Exalted Knight** only. The bearer has UNYIELDING 6+ from the start.

enhancements.name: Heirloom Lance
enhancements.description: **Gallant-Class Knight** only. +1 Damage in melee on a round it charged.

stratagems.name: Rotate Ion-Shields
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit is selected to Shoot a Class 3–5 unit
stratagems.effect: Treat the attacker as in the front arc for this attack.

stratagems.name: Trophy Kill
stratagems.turn: A Class 4–5 unit destroys an enemy Leader
stratagems.effect: Fulfil any Oath that targets Leaders; heal D3 MIGHT.

stratagems.name: Knightly Challenge
stratagems.turn: A Class 4–5 unit is selected to Fight
stratagems.effect: Choose one enemy model: all its attacks target that model (precision).

detachments.name: Squire Hunt
detachments.playstyle: Packs of squire-walkers bonded to a parent knight.

rules.name: Bondsman Hunt
rules.description: Squire-Walkers within 9″ of a Knight they are Bonded to (pick at deployment, up to 2 per Knight) get +1 to Hit against the last enemy unit that Knight attacked.

enhancements.name: Huntmaster's Horn
enhancements.description: **Paladin-Class Knight** only. Bonded Squire-Walkers within 9″ get +1 to Hit with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Pincer Strike
stratagems.turn: Two Squire-Walkers attack the same target this round

stratagems.name: Flushed from Cover
stratagems.turn: A Squire-Walker hits an enemy unit in Cover
stratagems.effect: That unit loses Cover until the End of Round.

stratagems.name: Covering Advance
stratagems.effect: It may make a 3″ move after shooting.

detachments.name: Feudal Muster
detachments.playstyle: The whole household marches: retainers screen the knights.

rules.name: Towering Bulwark
rules.description: Friendly Class 1–2 units within 3″ of a Class 4–5 Knight claim Cover; Knights may move over Class 1–2 enemy models.

enhancements.name: Banner of the House
enhancements.description: **Banner-Squire** only. Friendly Class 1–2 units within 6″ get +1 ARM (to 3+ cap).

enhancements.name: Veteran Sergeant-at-Arms
enhancements.description: **Herald-Seneschal** only. The attached unit gets +1 to Hit with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Hold the Line, Squires!
stratagems.effect: It is not Rattled and its Retaliation Strike gets +1 to Wound.

stratagems.name: Close the Gap
stratagems.turn: A Class 1–2 unit is destroyed within 6″ of a Knight
stratagems.effect: That Knight may make a 3″ move.

stratagems.name: Muster Call
stratagems.effect: Return a destroyed Feudal Squires unit at half strength within 6″ of your table edge.
